polls.description: China's rapid AI advancement with cheaper models and aggressive deployment is disrupting Western tech dominance and triggering geopolitical concerns.
polls.question: Should the US restrict access to Chinese AI models?

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek's new AI model is by far the cheapest of well-known models to run, research firm says
cluster_stories.summary: A version of Chinese startup DeepSeek's flagship AI model is by far ​the least expensive to run on ​benchmark tests among well-known models globally and more than 100 times cheaper to ​run than Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, according to a research firm.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK MODEL 100X CHEAPER THAN CLAUDE... Game-Changer for AI Economics

cluster_stories.title: Chinese military researchers tap US AI models to train defence systems
cluster_stories.summary: The previously unreported findings offer a rare glimpse into how military and security-linked institutions in China are leveraging cutting-edge U.S. AI models as a shortcut to developing specialised systems of their own, despite Washington's efforts to restrict Beijing's access to advanced chips and other strategic technologies.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA MILITARY SECRETLY TRAINS ON US AI MODELS

cluster_stories.title: China’s AI Blitz Creates ‘Death Zone’ for Rival US Model Makers
cluster_stories.summary: A flurry of model launches from China’s AI sector is rapidly narrowing the gap with Silicon Valley and creating what’s been described as a death zone for anyone without frontier-pushing technology or market-breaking pricing.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA AI BLITZ CREATES 'DEATH ZONE' FOR US RIVALS

cluster_stories.headline: ALIBABA UNVEILS MOST POWERFUL AI MODEL... Rivals Moonshot in Scale

cluster_stories.title: Stock market turmoil sheds stark light on the opaque AI economy

On Monday, the Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT floated on the Shanghai stock market, soaring by 466% in value to 3.3tn yuan (£365bn). Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA AI CHIP SHOCK CRASHES MARKETS: Western Dominance Shaken

cluster_stories.title: China’s tech advances are causing chaos from Silicon Valley to the White House
cluster_stories.summary: New AI models, advanced robots and specialty computer chips are unsettling markets and the US tech industryOver the past month, a series of advancements in China’s artificial intelligence, chip manufacturing and robotics technologies have rattled financial markets, caused divisions among US tech moguls and left the Trump administration scrambling to respond.Silicon Valley has long pointed to China’s tech industry as a competitive threat and used its growth as rationale for why US firms should not face regulatory oversight that could slow them down. In recent weeks, however, China’s progress has pushed US tech CEOs past vague warnings and into open disagreement over how to address Chinese-made products upending their industry. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA'S AI BOOM ROCKS SILICON VALLEY AND WHITE HOUSE

cluster_stories.title: Enhance use of AI to develop 'intelligent military': Xi tells PLA
cluster_stories.summary: Xi, who also heads the military, told a Politburo group study session on Thursday that the PLA should "strengthen the military application of unmanned intelligent technologies, deepen the development and application of network information systems, and gradually build an intelligent military system", the state-run Xinhua news agency reported.
cluster_stories.headline: XI ORDERS PLA: Build 'Intelligent Military' with AI

polls.description: European Union's comprehensive AI transparency and labeling requirements are now taking effect, marking a major shift in AI governance.
polls.question: Will EU AI labeling requirements protect users or create disclosure fatigue?

cluster_stories.title: EU enforces mandatory labelling of AI-generated content
cluster_stories.summary: Under the new rules, companies operating AI systems, such as chatbots, must inform users that they are interacting with artificial intelligence. Text, images and other content generated using AI must also carry clear labels, which may include watermarks or other markers to facilitate identification.
cluster_stories.headline: EU MANDATES AI CONTENT LABELING... MAJOR TRANSPARENCY PUSH

cluster_stories.title: AI’s ‘cookie banner’ moment: EU labels come for the bots
cluster_stories.summary: New regulations require companies to label chatbots, deepfakes and AI-generated marketing material

cluster_stories.title: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
cluster_stories.summary: The European Union has ushered in some additional rules that aim to make it easier for people to identify chatbots and AI deepfakes online. The new transparency obligations under the bloc's landmark AI Act came into effect on August 2nd, requiring companies to disclose when people are interacting with AI models, and if content has […]
cluster_stories.headline: EU AI Transparency Rules NOW IN EFFECT: Deepfakes Must Be Labeled

cluster_stories.title: Britain says it is open to AI regulation if voluntary safeguards fall short
cluster_stories.summary: The UK government is contemplating the regulation of advanced AI models if ongoing voluntary testing proves insufficient. Unlike the stringent EU AI Act, officials are inclined towards a more lenient regulatory approach. Recent incidents involving AI have sparked renewed discussions on the necessity for enhanced oversight of advanced AI systems.
cluster_stories.headline: UK Open to AI Regulation if Voluntary Safeguards Fail

cluster_stories.title: Explainer: EU gets new powers over powerful AI from Sunday
cluster_stories.summary: The EU has the world's most comprehensive digital rulebook covering social media, online retailers and search engines, with plans for more rules this year. In 2024, the EU adopted a sweeping AI law known as the "AI Act", but its rules have been introduced in stages.
cluster_stories.headline: EU AI Regulations TAKE EFFECT Sunday

cluster_stories.title: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
cluster_stories.summary: New EU rules stipulate that people must be told when they’re interacting with AI or looking at AI-generated or -edited content, leading to fear of “disclosure fatigue.”
cluster_stories.headline: EU AI DISCLOSURE RULES GO LIVE... 'Fatigue' Fears Mount
